input.query:
WITH ['/pulsar-broker-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-broker-common-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-client-original-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-client-api-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-common-4.2.5.jar','/pulsar-metadata-4.2.5.jar','/managed-ledger-4.2.5.jar'] AS jars
MATCH (a:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Type) WHERE a.fileName IN jars AND t.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.apache.pulsar.' AND NOT t:Inner
MATCH (a2:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(s:Type)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(t) WHERE a2.fileName IN jars AND s.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.apache.pulsar.' AND s<>t AND NOT s.fqn STARTS WITH t.fqn+'$'
RETURN t.fqn AS fqn, count(DISTINCT s) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 12
